fusions.name: Belly-Low Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then rakes it with your weapon for 12 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Toy with the Catch
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: a swat for 8 damage that uses it up and adds half its remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Twitching Lure
fusions.desc: Drops your tail, which thrashes where it lands for 10 seconds and lashes an enemy within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Tail for a Life
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused and leaves you at 1 health.
